issue.title: lambda layer using tf.image

repository.name: frugally-deep
repository.description: A lightweight header-only library for using Keras (TensorFlow) models in C++.

issue.body:
I am using Lambda layer which includes this function to extract patches in image

patch_one = tf.image.extract_glimpse(inputs[0], [26, 26], inputs[1][:, j, :], centered=False, normalized=False, noise='zero')

Is it possible to implement this custom layer in your library and load model?

body: I am able to reproduce the issue on Colab with Tensorflow 1.14.0 and works as expected with 2.0.0.beta1.
